ANA.name: Ryan Poehling
ANA.comment: Poehling (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Ducks on Wednesday.

ANA.name: A.J. Greer
ANA.comment: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

ANA.name: Ian Moore
ANA.comment: Moore (lower body) might be an option to play by the end of the week, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Wednesday.

BOS.name: James Hagens
BOS.comment: Head coach Marco Sturm announced Saturday that Hagens (back) is expected to miss multiple weeks, per Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now.

BUF.name: Matt Grzelcyk
BUF.comment: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

BUF.name: Justin Danforth
BUF.comment: Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.

CGY.name: Kevin Bahl
CGY.comment: Bahl will undergo surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon and won't play again in the 2026-27 season, the Flames announced Sunday.

CGY.name: Jonathan Huberdeau
CGY.comment: Huberdeau (hip) won't travel with the Flames during their upcoming three-game road trip, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports Friday.

CHI.name: Bowen Byram
CHI.comment: Byram (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

DAL.name: Miro Heiskanen
DAL.comment: Heiskanen (upper body) has been ruled out against the Sabres on Saturday, Stars TV host Brien Rea reports.

DAL.name: Matt Duchene
DAL.comment: Duchene will be out for approximately three months after undergoing surgery to repair a core injury, the team announced Monday.

DAL.name: Lian Bichsel
DAL.comment: Bichsel (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

DAL.name: Oskar Back
DAL.comment: Back was placed on long-term injured reserve on Saturday.

DAL.name: Kyle Capobianco
DAL.comment: Capobianco (leg) was moved to long-term injured reserve Saturday.

DET.name: Albert Johansson
DET.comment: Johansson (undisclosed) will be with the Red Wings for their upcoming four-game road trip, Ansar Khan of MLive.com reports Friday.

DET.name: Simon Edvinsson
DET.comment: Edvinsson (contract dispute) is on the Red Wings' injured, non-roster list, per the NHL media site Wednesday.

EDM.name: Matt Savoie
EDM.comment: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.

EDM.name: Alec Regula
EDM.comment: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.

EDM.name: Frederik Andersen
EDM.comment: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.

EDM.name: Mattias Janmark
EDM.comment: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.

FLA.name: Brad Marchand
FLA.comment: Head coach Paul Maurice said Friday that Marchand (knee) will travel with the Panthers during their upcoming three-game road trip, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.

FLA.name: Aleksander Barkov
FLA.comment: Head coach Paul Maurice said Friday that Barkov (knee) will travel with the Panthers during their upcoming three-game road trip, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports.

FLA.name: Jonah Gadjovich
FLA.comment: Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.

MIN.name: Brock Faber
MIN.comment: Faber (skull) has told the Wild that he's ready to play and expects to return for Saturday's game against the Bruins, Michael Russo of The Athletic reports Wednesday.

MIN.name: Filip Gustavsson
MIN.comment: Gustavsson (hip) will travel with the Wild during the team's upcoming three-game road trip, per Joe Smith of The Athletic.

MTL.name: Ivan Demidov
MTL.comment: Demidov (foot) skated Tuesday and could resume training with the team next week, Patrick Friolet of RDS reports.

MTL.name: Sam Montembeault
MTL.comment: Montembeault (lower body) is considered day-to-day, according to Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports on Saturday.

NJD.name: Johnathan Kovacevic
NJD.comment: The Devils placed Kovacevic (ankle) on injured reserve Friday, retroactive to Nov. 10.

NJD.name: Anthony Mantha
NJD.comment: Mantha (throat) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Devils on Wednesday, retroactive to Nov. 7.

NJD.name: Seamus Casey
NJD.comment: Casey (knee) was moved to long-term injured reserve on Friday, per PuckPedia.

NYI.name: Mathew Barzal
NYI.comment: Barzal (knee) won't be in the lineup against the Sharks on Monday but has been upgraded to day-to-day, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports.

NYR.name: Sean Durzi
NYR.comment: Durzi (undisclosed) was put on injured reserve Thursday, per Mollie Walker of the New York Post.

NYR.name: Joe Veleno
NYR.comment: Veleno (lower body) was placed on long-term injured reserve Saturday, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports.

NYR.name: Igor Shesterkin
NYR.comment: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

OTT.name: William Eklund
OTT.comment: Eklund had surgery to repair a torn ankle tendon and will be out 10-12 weeks, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports Thursday.

OTT.name: Warren Foegele
OTT.comment: Foegele (knee) will miss 3-4 weeks, Jackson Starr of the Senators' official site reports Saturday.

PHI.name: Nikita Grebenkin
PHI.comment: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.

PIT.name: Bryan Rust
PIT.comment: Rust (lower body) will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Michelle Crechiolo of the Penguins' official site reports Thursday.

PIT.name: Elmer Soderblom
PIT.comment: Soderblom (upper body) is week-to-week, per Penguins PR on Monday.

PIT.name: Ryan Graves
PIT.comment: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

SJS.name: Quentin Musty
SJS.comment: Musty (upper body) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday, according to Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

SJS.name: Kyle Keyser
SJS.comment: Keyser (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by the Sharks on Monday, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

SEA.name: Jared McCann
SEA.comment: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.

SEA.name: Jacob Melanson
SEA.comment: Melanson (chest) will be a game-time call for Saturday's clash with the Hurricanes, Tom Gulitti of NHL.com reports.

SEA.name: Jake O'Brien
SEA.comment: O'Brien (lower body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Wednesday.

STL.name: Torey Krug
STL.comment: Krug (ankle) was placed on long-term injured reserve by the Blues on Monday, per PuckPedia.

STL.name: Tyler Tucker
STL.comment: Tucker had arthroscopic knee surgery and will be re-assessed in six weeks, the team announced Wednesday.

TOR.name: Nick Blankenburg
TOR.comment: Blankenburg (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Maple Leafs on Friday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

TOR.name: Miles Wood
TOR.comment: Wood (undisclosed) was transferred to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

TOR.name: Max Domi
TOR.comment: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.

TOR.name: Elvis Merzlikins
TOR.comment: Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.

UTA.name: Nate Schmidt
UTA.comment: The Mammoth announced Thursday that Schmidt (upper body) is considered week-to-week, Cole Bagley of KSL Sports reports.

VAN.name: Thatcher Demko
VAN.comment: Co-president of hockey operations Henrik Sedin said Monday that he hopes Demko (hip) will be ready to return before Christmas, Kevin Woodley of NHL.com reports.

WSH.name: Rasmus Sandin
WSH.comment: Sandin (knee) will be with the Capitals for their two-game road trip, Tarik El-Bashir of Monumental Sports Network reports Monday.

WPG.name: Dylan DeMelo
WPG.comment: DeMelo (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Friday.

WPG.name: Isak Rosen
WPG.comment: Rosen (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Blackhawks, Ken Wiebe of The Winnipeg Free Press reports.

WPG.name: Nick Bjugstad
WPG.comment: Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.
